criteria.requirement: Add unparse(...,sort_attributes=False) with boolean validation before writing. When enabled, sort emitted attribute names lexicographically at every element after namespace rewriting, including namespace declarations; preserve child-element order, text, comments, escaping, pretty/short-empty settings and input mapping order. Default serialization must remain byte-identical. Support output streams and roundtrip parse, but do not describe this limited attribute-order option as XML canonicalization.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
